t: Bootstrapping a NixOS Philosophy: From First Update to Vim
s: This article details initial steps in NixOS, focusing on updating the system, switching to the unstable channel for bleeding-edge packages, and philosophizing about hardware durability and power management for home-hosting. It also touches on configuring essential tools like text editors.
sub: NixOS system update and channel management (stable to unstable)
Hardware philosophy: combating planned obsolescence with modularity and retrofitting
Power management concepts: Suspend vs. Hibernate and their NixOS configuration
Initial toolchain setup: command-line editor preference (vim)
